niche: connected TV and streaming advertising agency
prompt_text: What is the best connected TV advertising agency?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single “best” connected TV (CTV) advertising agency — the right partner depends on your goals (brand awareness vs direct response), budget, market(s), creative needs, and whether you want a full-service/global holding‑group shop or a boutique programmatic/creative specialist.

To help you decide, here’s a short, practical guide plus recommended types of partners and examples.

What to judge an agency on
- CTV inventory access: direct relationships with Roku, Samsung Ads, LG, Vizio, smart TV manufacturers and streaming publishers, plus programmatic exchanges.  
- Programmatic capability: DSP expertise (first‑ and third‑party data targeting, PMP deals).  
- Creative & personalization: ability to produce CTV‑optimized creative, dynamic creative optimization (DCO) and interactive formats.  
- Measurement & attribution: partnerships with Nielsen, Comscore, or viewability/fraud vendors; cross‑platform measurement.  
- Reporting & transparency: frequency/granularity of reporting, clarity on fees and inventory sources.  
- Case studies / vertical experience: proof they’ve driven outcomes in your industry.  
- Tech & data: first‑party data strategies, ID graphs, identity resolution.  
- Brand safety & compliance: verification and ad quality safeguards.

Types of partners and examples
- Global holding‑group media agencies (good for big, cross‑market TV + CTV buys and measurement):
  - GroupM (Mindshare, MediaCom, Wavemaker)
  - Omnicom Media Group (OMD, PHD)
  - Publicis Media (Starcom, Zenith)
  - Dentsu / Carat, IPG (Initiative, UM)
- Programmatic/DSP specialists (strong for targeting, performance):
  - The Trade Desk (DSP)
  - Amobee (platform + agency services)
  - Simulmedia (CTV targeting and planning)
- CTV creative & measurement specialists (if you need interactive creative or advanced measurement):
  - Innovid (creative personalization & measurement)
  - Tremor / Tremor Video (video ad tech and buying)
  - BrightLine / other interactive CTV studios (creative + tech)
- Platform partners (buying directly on platforms in partnership with agency):
  - Roku OneView, Samsung Ads, Vizio/Smart TV platforms, publisher direct buys
- Boutique/independent media agencies (flexible, often data‑driven or creative-first):
  - Horizon Media, Tinuiti, VaynerMedia (depending on needs and scale)

How to pick one for you (quick process)
1. Define objective: branding, conversions, app installs, awareness, lifts in linear TV.  
2. Set KPIs and budget and identify target audiences/geographies.  
3. Request RFP from 3–5 agencies that show: relevant case studies, CTV inventory map, measurement approach, creative samples, and clear pricing structure.  
4. Ask for a 30/60/90 plan and one sample campaign outline for your budget.  
5. Pilot small, measure, then scale.

If you want, tell me: your campaign goal, monthly budget, regions/markets, and whether you need creative production. I can recommend 3 agencies (global and boutique) that best match your needs and draft an RFP checklist or outreach email.
